settings.title: Are there paid collaboration opportunities?
settings.content: Yes, we do offer paid collaborations on a case-by-case basis, with a focus on alignment and ROI. Feel free to apply and inquire—just email us your details, including any relevant info or a media kit.

settings.title: How do I track my earnings?
settings.content: Log in to your affiliate dashboard  to track your referrals, commissions, and payouts—and to access marketing materials and more.

settings.title: How do I get started?
settings.content:
If you don’t yet own a Glow, Hearth, Shower Sauna Conversion Kit, or FireLight® Sauna, start with our risk-free 100-Day Trial.

Already a product owner? You’re welcome to apply now!

settings.title: When and how do I get paid?
settings.content: We pay out commissions via PayPal or store credit. Payouts occur within the first two weeks following the end of the referral customer's 100-Day Trial, which is about a 107-114 day cycle.

settings.title: Can I use my discount code myself?
settings.content: Yes, you are allowed to use your discount code for your own personal purchases.

settings.title: What marketing materials are available to affiliates?
settings.content: In your affiliate dashboard, click on the Marketing Tools tab to access all your marketing materials.
